name: RULER · long-context accuracy
attribution: NVIDIA / RULER authors; contributing model authors identified in the source notes
scope: Source README accuracy at six measured context lengths. Claimed and effective length differ. Includes contributing-author reports; see original notes for FILM, Qwen, Jamba and EXAONE protocol exceptions. Missing lengths are absent, never zero. No third-party task corpora redistributed.
selection: All available numeric 4K–128K context columns for model rows; aggregate weighted rankings not imported.
maintenance: Checked daily for updates within this exact selection. Source licenses and supported formats are checked before acceptance; blocked sources retain the last accepted snapshot. Historical and preliminary scope still applies.
changes: Selected numerical results; fields renamed and evaluation slices labeled. Original numerical scales retained. Questions, paper images, transcripts, contacts and trajectories excluded.
